body.message:
Hi, my name is Camelia. I really like the apartment for rent and would like to know a couple of things: 
-does the AED can be paid on a monthly basis? 
-can the apartment be available to move in next 18th of July? 
-is there any deposit to be made? 
-is the price of AED permanent or does it changes over the months? How much could it increase? 
Is there any obligation to stay X months? What is the notice period?
-does the price include bills as water, electricity, wifi? 

I am interesting to find a property as soon as possible so would really appreciate your assistance with those questions. I would also like to arrange an apartment view if possible next Friday afternoon. 

Thank you very much, 
Kind regards,
